compat.text: Prepare the substrate mechanically using a suitable technique. 1. Remove any debris from pockets or holes for structural fixings. 2. Clean all substrate surfaces using industrial vacuuming equipment to remove dust and contaminants that may reduce adhesion. 3. The substrate has an open-textured, gripping surface profile
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

compat.text: Prepare the substrate mechanically using a suitable technique such as blast-cleaning or grinding. 1. Clean all substrate surfaces using industrial vacuuming equipment to remove dust and contaminants that may reduce adhesion. 2. Apply Sikadur®-53 as soon as possible to prevent re-oxidizing and rust formation. 3. CRACK INJECTION Cracks must be clean
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

compat.text: If applying to matt damp concrete, brush Sikadur®-53 well into the substrate. 1. GROUTING RESIN Select suitable formwork (permanent or temporary) of sufficient strength to contain the grout around areas such as base plates. 1. Ensure all edges and joints of the formwork are sealed tightly to prevent leakage or seepage of the grout. 2. Coat all surfaces of the formwork that will come into contact with the grout with polyethylene film or release agent to prevent adhesion. 3. Pour the mixed Sikadur®-53 into the formwork from one or two sides only
